spec.title: Fungi icon: round 2, redesigned from what Fungi does

questions.prompt: Which idea should the mark carry?
questions.context:
Round 1 dropped every mushroom and any tie to the name. Fungi's job, from the README and wiki:

> An agent opens an interface for a person, then **sleeps without polling** while they take their time. Fungi **saves the answer durably** and **wakes the agent** with the result. It's headless, so other projects supply the interface.

Pick the idea separately from the drawing, so a weak drawing doesn't sink a strong idea. The drawings that carry each idea are listed after it.
questions.recommendation: Sleeps until pinged. It's the thing Fungi does that other tools don't. The planning notes call it central: no repeated tool calls, polling, or token spend while the person is away.

options.label: Round trip: work goes out to a person and comes back to the agent (Boomerang)
The agent sleeps until it's pinged, with no polling and nothing spent while you're away (Doze, Mailbox)
Nothing gets lost: answers are saved before they're acknowledged (Receipt)

questions.prompt: Which drawing should we take further?
questions.context:
- **Boomerang**: A glossy boomerang in flight with a dotted path curving back. **Round trip**: Fungi sends work out to a person and it comes back to the agent.
- **Mailbox**: A rural mailbox with its flag up. **The flag tells you**: the answer lands in the box and the agent doesn't keep checking. That's the no-polling promise.
- **Doze**: A sleeping speech-bubble character with a notification badge. **Sleeps until pinged**: the agent spends nothing while you take your time, then gets woken.
- **Socket**: A flat outlet that doubles as a surprised face, on neon lime. **Headless**: Fungi has no UI of its own, and any interface plugs in.
- **Resume**: A dimmed pause bar beside a glowing play triangle. **Pause, then play**: the agent pauses, the person acts, the agent resumes.
- **Receipt**: A paper receipt with a check stamp. **Nothing is lost**: every answer is saved before it's acknowledged, and you get a receipt.

Each card shows the full icon, then 40 / 24 / 16px on light, plus a circle crop and 24 / 16px on dark. Use Notes to mix ideas, e.g. *Doze's character with Socket's flat lime treatment*. A flat one-color version for favicons comes after we pick a direction.
questions.recommendation: Doze. It carries the sleeps-until-pinged idea and has the most character, in line with the reference. Risk: below 24px it can pass for a chat app's notification icon. If that bothers you, take Mailbox for the same idea or Resume for a pure symbol.

options.label: Mailbox: flag goes up when it's done

answers.notes:
they are all unsuitable. i was hoping for something more serious feeling. less-playful. 

fungi is an interaction engine, presenting interactive experiences to users, allowing for communication, alignment, feedback, data collection, etc.  it operates by presenting a window pane, allowing for skills to author their own interface or workflow.
